description: Team of passionate space people from across the world.
summary: Ares-01 is a browser-based 3D game for the Space Mission Design Game challenge. Players choose one of six crew roles and work with five rule-based teammates to design a Perseverance-inspired Mars rover mission. They select a landing site, set science priorities, and balance instruments, payload mass, power, communications, and budget. On Mars, they plan each sol, drive to targets, operate instruments, and prioritize science data for transmission to Earth. A mission dossier explains how their decisions shaped the science returned. NASA and JPL references ground the engineering models, helping players understand how mission constraints affect scientific discovery.
details:
Ares-01 connects mission design to 3D rover operations. Players choose one of six crew roles, each represented by an ASTROCREW team member, and work with five rule-based teammates whose specialties shape their advice and proposals. They select Jezero, Northeast Syrtis, or Columbia Hills and rank objectives in geology, potential biosignature context, and environmental science. Players choose from seven Perseverance instruments and review trade-offs in payload mass, battery reserve, relay capacity, launch options, and budget before committing to a mission.

On Mars, players allocate time for driving and instrument work, investigate targets, and prioritize science data for transmission to Earth. The game tracks science collected and science returned separately, so valuable observations can remain onboard when communications are limited. The final dossier records decisions and outcomes, encouraging players to compare mission designs. Static NASA and JPL references inform rover and instrument specifications; terrain, costs, hazards, and operating schedules include educational assumptions. Potential biosignature context does not establish evidence of life.

The browser application uses React, TypeScript, and Vite. Three.js renders the rover, crew, and terrain, while Zustand manages mission state. Playwright and Node.js scripts support interface and engineering checks. OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT assisted with code, game content, 3D assets, testing, debugging, deployment, and documentation. ASTROCREW developed the concept, set the scientific objectives, directed implementation, and reviewed the results.
